greeting: --and I am Ash, the renewal. Together--
dialog.shop_open: We offer fire-blessed goods. Warmth--protection. Purification through flame.
dialog.shop_prompt: Sacred flame items. Candles that never--extinguish. Charms of warmth.
rumor: Our white sisters tend moon shrine.--
The sun and moon reader visits--
A black coat asked about our flame.--
dialog.quest_hook: Sacred coals must be refreshed. Need embers from the--Phoenix Perch. Dangerous climb. But the flame calls.--Bring coals. We will reward with fire's favor.
dialog.quest_active: Phoenix Perch. Highest point. Embers still--warm. Careful. Fire tests the worthy.
dialog.quest_complete: The coals! Still warm! The eternal flame--burns brighter! Here. Flame-blessed armor. Protection--and power. You are fire-friend now.
dialog.time_dawn: Morning fire. New day's warmth--born from night's ashes.
dialog.time_noon: Sun at peak. Fire answers sun--in competition. Both bright.
dialog.time_dusk: Evening. Fire becomes more--precious. Light against dark.
dialog.time_night: Night belongs to flame. We tend--until dawn. Always vigilant.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: Fire-bringer returns! The shrine--burns brighter for your service.

party_reactions.kade: Twins again? This place loves pairs.
party_reactions.twist: Fire! Pretty fire! Can I touch?
party_reactions.korr: The fire is true. These ones are true.

relationship_dialog.stranger: New to flame. We see--potential. Uncertainty.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Returning to warmth. Fire--remembers. We remember.
relationship_dialog.friend: Fire-friend. Trusted with--sacred flame. Honor bound.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You carry our flame now.--Part of us. Part of fire.

mini_quest.title: Flame's Refresh
mini_quest.description: Retrieve sacred coals from Phoenix Perch to refresh the eternal flame

stages.hook: Sacred coals must be refreshed. Need embers from Phoenix Perch. Dangerous climb. But flame calls. Will you answer?
stages.active: Phoenix Perch. Highest point. Embers still warm. Careful. Fire tests the worthy. Don't get burned!
stages.complete: The coals! Still warm! Eternal flame burns brighter! Here. Flame-blessed armor. Protection and power. Fire-friend!
